correctness.rationale: The finite matroid is explicitly specified; all independent faces and translation orbit flags are enumerated. Burnside counts agree; the full signed boundary squares to zero; 311 integral unit cancellations lead to a 4-by-4 matrix with exact determinantal divisors (2,8,32,128), giving H2=Z/2 + (Z/4)^3, H3=H1=0. K is simply connected due to full two-skeleton, and each of eight group elements has a fixed point, so Armstrong makes quotient π1 trivial. A 3-dimensional simply connected CW complex has a wedge-of-2-spheres two-skeleton and 3-cell attaching maps classified by the integral Smith matrix, yielding the precise Moore-space wedge. Standalone package code reproduces all finite certificates, with limitations explicitly distinguished.

value.rationale: The canonical rank-four eight-point binary affine geometry has natural regular translations, and its nonfree orbit space exhibits three independent Z/4 torsion summands despite the acting group having exponent two and the cover being a wedge of 21 3-spheres. This gives a complete integral homotopy type, a structural and potentially useful boundary between rational equivariance and integral orbit topology; it is neither a generic shellability corollary nor an arbitrary table entry.
